item.title: Kyrgios Defeats Sabalenka in Controversial 'Battle of the Sexes' Exhibition, Sparks Outrage with Bold Claims
item.description: Nick Kyrgios defeated women's world No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka 6-3, 6-3 in a controversial "Battle of the Sexes" exhibition in Dubai on December 28, 2025. Despite modified rules to level the playing field, Kyrgios' post-match claims—that the event was the most talked-about in sport recently and that he's among a rare few to beat the Big Four—sparked widespread backlash and debate over its impact on women's tennis. item.title: Turkish Cypriot Media: Changes to Entry Procedures for Cypriots into Turkey – What You Need to Know
item.description: Starting January 2, 2026, holders of Republic of Cyprus passports can no longer obtain a sticker visa on arrival in Turkey. Travelers must secure an e-visa online in advance or apply through Turkish diplomatic missions. This change does not affect Turkish Cypriots, who continue visa-free entry.
